verdict.rationale: AgentMail's evidence covers its email API, SDK, MCP server, and CLI, but there is no mention of keyboard shortcuts or a command palette in its dashboard/web UI. In fact, community reports describe the web interface as laggy and slow to load (WebGL errors, notable UI lag), undermining any 'fast enough to never wait' claim even though no such claim was made. missing for 10: any documentation of keyboard shortcuts, command palette, or UI speed benchmarks.
